kvkk_dialog_title: Video Verification — KVKK Privacy Notice & Disclaimer
kvkk_section1_body: MedTrack Plus (the "Application") acts as the data controller within the scope of the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK"). This notice has been prepared to inform you about the personal data that will be processed when you enable the video verification feature.
kvkk_section2_body: When you enable this feature, short video clips recorded with your front camera during medication intake verification sessions are processed. The recordings may include your facial image and visual data relating to pill intake. In addition, technical data such as the device identifier, session timestamp, verification score and classification result are processed.
kvkk_section3_title: 3. Purpose of Processing and Legal Basis
kvkk_section3_body: The data is processed solely to verify medication intake, to inform the patient's relatives and to improve service quality. The legal basis is your EXPLICIT CONSENT pursuant to Article 5/1 of the KVKK. Without your consent, no video recording is captured, uploaded to the server or stored.
kvkk_section4_body: Uploaded videos are stored on Firebase Storage for only 24 hours per session and are automatically deleted at the end of this period. Verification metadata (score, timestamp, etc.) is retained on Firestore for service records.
kvkk_section5_body: The video recording may be viewed only by the patient relatives you have authorized, through the authorized account they have signed in with. It is not transferred to any third parties or to any organization for advertising purposes.
kvkk_section6_body: Pursuant to Article 11 of the KVKK, you have the right to access your data and to request its rectification, erasure or the cessation of its processing. You may submit such requests by turning off the "Video Verification Recording" switch in the in-app Settings section or by writing to plus.medtrack@gmail.com.
kvkk_section7_body: Video verification is an artificial-intelligence-based support tool and does not guarantee 100% accuracy. System outputs do not constitute medical advice. The MedTrack Plus team cannot be held liable for false positive/negative results, missing recordings, or any health consequences arising from whether or not the user takes their medication properly. All responsibility regarding medication therapy rests with the user and their healthcare provider.
kvkk_section8_body: I hereby acknowledge and declare that I have read and understood all of the provisions above, and that I give my explicit consent to the capture of the video recording, its storage on the server for 24 hours, its sharing with my patient relatives and its subsequent automatic deletion. I am aware that I may withdraw this consent at any time via Settings.
kvkk_checkbox_accept: I have read and accept the entire text above.
kvkk_scroll_hint: Please scroll to the end of the text to continue.
